title.value: NL-PS-L3-B - Level 3b: One maximal GBB per section - Patient id query - JSON Format

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 3b test patient, in which every mandatory section except Medication summary has at least one entry, each with a maximal generic building block (GBB), and has a narrative, and Medication summary has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 3b test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
Patient.id of your level 3b test patient, without 'Patient/'.
The id of the first Patient Summary Composition in the search result.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).first().id

description.value: Search the NL-PS Composition of the test patient with the Patient id entered at test setup.
Search the Patient Summary Compositions of the patient: GET [base]/Composition?type=http://loinc.org|60591-5&patient=${patient-id-3b}
Confirm that the operation was successful
Confirm that the response is a searchset Bundle.

expression.value: Bundle.type = 'searchset'

description.value: Confirm that the search result contains at least one Patient Summary Composition. Without one, step 2 cannot run.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).exists()

description.value: Confirm that the search result contains exactly one Patient Summary. If there are more, step 2 uses the first one in the order of the server: check the Composition id in the request of step 2 to see which one was tested. Use a token that only gives access to one test patient to avoid this.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).count() = 1

name.value: Retrieve and check Patient Summary document

description.value: Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check the document as a whole. The next tests check the Patient and each section of this document.
Retrieve the Patient Summary as a document: GET [base]/Composition/[id]/$document
Confirm that the operation was successful
Confirm that the response is a Bundle.
Confirm that the Bundle is a document. (FHIR R4 allows a server to wrap the document in a searchset Bundle; that is not accepted here.)

expression.value: Bundle.type = 'document'

description.value: Confirm that the first entry of the document is a Composition.
Confirm that the Composition is a Patient Summary (type LOINC 60591-5).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).type.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '60591-5').exists()

description.value: Confirm that the document conforms to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle.
Confirm that the Composition conforms to http://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/StructureDefinition/nl-PatientSummary, and through it to the EU-PS profile it imposes.

Validate the Patient that the Composition refers to against nl-core-Patient and, as a warning, against the EU-PS Patient profile patient-eu-eps, in the document retrieved in test "Retrieve and check Patient Summary document".
Confirm that Composition.subject refers to exactly one Patient in the document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).count() = 1

description.value: Confirm that the Patient conforms to http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Patient.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).resource

description.value: Confirm that the Patient conforms to http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/patient-eu-eps. A failure is reported as a warning.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).resource

description.value: Check section Problems (LOINC 11450-4) in the document retrieved in test "Retrieve and check Patient Summary document". The section must have at least one entry. If not, the remaining checks of this test are skipped. The Condition of the first entry is validated against, and checked for the SHALL:populate and SHOULD:populate-if-known elements of, nl-core-Condition; further entries are not validated.
